attributes.title: alarm_status
attributes.description: Query current Alarm Events with validated filters via system.alarm.queryStatus. Domain alarm state is data, not Tool failure. Results are never silently truncated.

parameters.name: states
parameters.description: Optional states: ClearUnacked, ClearAcked, ActiveUnacked, ActiveAcked.

parameters.name: priorities
parameters.description: Optional priorities: Diagnostic, Low, Medium, High, Critical.

parameters.name: alarmPaths
parameters.description: Optional Alarm Path patterns; at most 50.

parameters.name: sourcePaths
parameters.description: Optional Source Path patterns; at most 50.

parameters.name: displayPaths
parameters.description: Optional Display Path patterns; at most 50.

parameters.name: providers
parameters.description: Optional Tag Provider names; at most 20.

parameters.name: allProperties
parameters.description: Up to 20 AND property conditions: {property, operator, value}; operators =, !=, <, <=, >, >=.

parameters.name: anyProperties
parameters.description: Up to 20 OR property conditions: {property, operator, value}; operators =, !=, <, <=, >, >=.

parameters.name: definedProperties
parameters.description: Property names that must exist; at most 20.

parameters.name: includeShelved
parameters.description: Whether shelved events are included. Default false.

parameters.name: maxResults
parameters.description: Maximum complete result count, 1..500. Default 100. Over-limit queries fail rather than truncate.
